name: hyperflow
description: Four Hyperflow workflows for planning, delegation, review and delegate configuration, with inert startup.

interface.shortDescription: Plan, delegate and review with your coding harness
interface.longDescription: Hyperflow keeps the current host as coordinator. Four lazy-loaded skills plan tasks, execute dependency-aware lanes through configured delegate harnesses, review pinned changes and configure delegate profiles. Per-task model and effort selections are explicit in the plan. Host capabilities and live evidence are reported separately.
